'''Marcel Salathé''' (born 1975 in [[Basel]]) is a Swiss digital [[epidemiologist]] and currently an associate professor at [[EPFL]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last=Evangelista|first=Sandy|date=2015-07-15|title=Welcome to our new SV professors|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/welcome-to-our-new-sv-professors/|language=en}}</ref> He is the PI of the Lab of Digital Epidemiology, and co-director of the EPFL AI Center.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Salathe Lab|url=https://www.epfl.ch/labs/salathelab/|access-date=2020-09-14|website=}}</ref> In the first year of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], Salathé was the most quoted scientist in the Swiss media.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Wissenschaft und Virus – "Corona hat mich stark politisiert"|url=https://www.derbund.ch/corona-hat-mich-stark-politisiert-515749154368|access-date=2021-02-17|website=Der Bund|date=2 January 2021 |language=de}}</ref>

== Career ==
From 1995 to 2002, Salathé studied [[biology]] at the [[University of Basel]]. In 2007, he graduated in [[biology]] and [[environmental science]]s at [[ETH Zurich]] with a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] on population genetics and evolutionary biology in the group of [[Sebastian Bonhoeffer]], where he thereafter pursued postdoctoral studies for one year.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Switzerl|first=Address ETH Zürich Dep of Environmental Systems Science Prof Dr Sebastian Bonhoeffer Institut für Integrative Biologie CHN K. 12 1 Universitätstrasse 16 8092 Zürich|title=Bonhoeffer, Sebastian, Prof. Dr. {{!}} ETH Zurich|url=https://usys.ethz.ch/en/people/profile.sebastian-bonhoeffer.html|access-date=2020-09-14|website=usys.ethz.ch|language=en}}</ref> In 2008, Salathé was awarded with a Society in Science Branco Weiss fellowship.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Marcel Salathé|url=https://brancoweissfellowship.org/alumni/salathe.html|access-date=2020-09-14|website=}}</ref> The same year he joined group of [[Marcus Feldman]] at [[Stanford University]] as a postdoctoral researcher.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|date=2010-12-14|title=Stanford research follows spread of flu in high school {{!}} Stanford News Release|url=https://news.stanford.edu/pr/2010/pr-track-flu-spread-121410.html|access-date=2020-09-14|website=news.stanford.edu|language=en|archive-date=2020-09-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200914035043/https://news.stanford.edu/pr/2010/pr-track-flu-spread-121410.html}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite journal|last1=Salathe|first1=M.|last2=Kazandjieva|first2=M.|last3=Lee|first3=J. W.|last4=Levis|first4=P.|last5=Feldman|first5=M. W.|last6=Jones|first6=J. H.|date=2010-12-21|title=A high-resolution human contact network for infectious disease transmission|journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences|language=en|volume=107|issue=51|pages=22020–22025|doi=10.1073/pnas.1009094108|pmid=21149721|pmc=3009790|arxiv=1006.4622|bibcode=2010PNAS..10722020S|issn=0027-8424|doi-access=free }}</ref> In 2010, he became assistant professor at the Center for Infectious Disease Dynamics at [[Pennsylvania State University]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Messages From the Director|url=https://www.huck.psu.edu/about/leadership/messages-from-the-director|access-date=2020-09-14|website=}}</ref>

In 2015, he was nominated associated professor at [[EPFL]]  with a double appointment at School of Computer and Communication Sciences and the School of Life Sciences,<ref name=":0" /> where he acts as a founding director of the Lab of Digital Epidemiology.<ref name=":2" /> In 2016, he founded the [[EPFL Extension School]], the EPFL online school for applied digital skills and has since served as its academic director.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Our Team|url=https://www.extensionschool.ch/our-team|access-date=2020-09-14|website=EPFL Extension School}}</ref>

In the course of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], Salathé became more widely known to a wider public mainly through multiple appearances in Swiss television<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-07-02|title=Zug und Tram sind nicht genug – Braucht es eine generelle Maskenpflicht, Marcel Salathé?|url=https://www.srf.ch/news/schweiz/zug-und-tram-sind-nicht-genug-braucht-es-eine-generelle-maskenpflicht-marcel-salathe|access-date=2020-08-07|website=Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen (SRF)|language=de}}</ref> and media outlets,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Swiss soldiers pick up smartphones to fight COVID-19|url=https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/reuters/swiss-soldiers-pick-up-smartphones-to-fight-covid-19/45730294|access-date=2020-08-07|website=SWI swissinfo.ch|language=en|archive-date=2021-04-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210423235050/https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/reuters/swiss-soldiers-pick-up-smartphones-to-fight-covid-19/45730294}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Rhyn|first=Larissa|title=Epidemiologe Marcel Salathé: Wie weiter nach dem Lockdown?|url=https://www.nzz.ch/schweiz/epidemiologe-marcel-salathe-wie-weiter-nach-dem-lockdown-ld.1549246|access-date=2020-08-07|website=Neue Zürcher Zeitung|date=31 March 2020 |language=de}}</ref> and in public lectures.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Papageorgiou|first=Nik|date=2020-02-27|title=We need to buy time for a vaccine against the coronavirus|url=https://actu.epfl.ch/news/we-need-to-buy-time-for-a-vaccine-against-the-coro/|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Coronavirus-Ausbruch: Was sagt die Wissenschaft? {{!}} reatch|url=https://www.reatch.ch/de/content/coronavirus-ausbruch-was-sind-die-fakten|access-date=2020-08-07|website=www.reatch.ch}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=2020-03-05|title=COVID-19: EPFL's Marcel Salathé course on Feb 26, 2020|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3RQBtA4dK9s|access-date=2020-09-14|website=[[YouTube]]}}</ref>  In November 2020, he was named director of the steering committee of the Swiss COVID-19 national research program.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Election of Steering Committee of NRP 78 "Covid-19" - SNF|url=http://www.snf.ch/en/researchinFocus/newsroom/Pages/news-201104-election-of-steering-committee-of-nrp-78-covid-19.aspx|access-date=2020-11-05|website=www.snf.ch}}</ref>

== Research ==
Salathé is interested in epidemiological problems, especially in contact networks. He analyses digital data streams (e.g. Twitter or mobile phones) in order to gain epidemiological insights.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Salathé|first1=Marcel|last2=Bengtsson|first2=Linus|last3=Bodnar|first3=Todd J.|last4=Brewer|first4=Devon D.|last5=Brownstein|first5=John S.|last6=Buckee|first6=Caroline|last7=Campbell|first7=Ellsworth M.|last8=Cattuto|first8=Ciro|last9=Khandelwal|first9=Shashank|last10=Mabry|first10=Patricia L.|last11=Vespignani|first11=Alessandro|date=2012-07-26|editor-last=Bourne|editor-first=Philip E.|title=Digital Epidemiology|journal=PLOS Computational Biology|language=en|volume=8|issue=7|article-number=e1002616|doi=10.1371/journal.pcbi.1002616|pmid=22844241|pmc=3406005|bibcode=2012PLSCB...8E2616S|issn=1553-7358 |doi-access=free }}</ref> He is the lead author of the paper Digital Epidemiology published in 2012 introducing the term digital epidemiology (e-epidemiology).<ref name=":4" /> In recent years, his research began to focus on [[nutritional epidemiology]], using digital and [[Artificial intelligence|AI]]-based tools to enable high-resolution food tracking in medical cohorts.<ref>{{Cite web|title=AI-assisted food tracking to revolutionize nutritional research - AI For Nutrition|url=https://www.aifornutrition.org/|access-date=2020-09-28|website=www.aifornutrition.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Lazzari|first1=Gianrocco|last2=Jaquet|first2=Yannis|last3=Kebaili|first3=Djilani J.|last4=Symul|first4=Laura|last5=Salathé|first5=Marcel|date=2018-07-04|title=FoodRepo: An Open Food Repository of Barcoded Food Products|journal=Frontiers in Nutrition|volume=5|article-number=57|doi=10.3389/fnut.2018.00057|issn=2296-861X|pmc=6040205|pmid=30023359|arxiv=1801.10195|doi-access=free}}</ref>

Since the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], his work focused also on digital contact tracing. He has been a member the group developing the [[Decentralized Privacy-Preserving Proximity Tracing]] algorithm,<ref>{{Cite web|title=DP-3T/documents|url=https://github.com/DP-3T/documents|access-date=2020-09-14|website=GitHub|language=en}}</ref> and the scientific lead behind the [[SwissCovid]] mobile phone application released by the Federal administration of Switzerland. The latter is the first digital contact tracing application developed by a government that is based on the [[Google]]'s and [[Apple Inc.|Apple]]'s [[Exposure Notification|Exposure Notifications System]].

Salathé is a co-founder of [[CH++]], a political action group for science-based policy development.<ref>{{Cite web |title=About |url=https://chplusplus.org/en/about/ |access-date=2024-09-02 |website=CH++ |language=en}}</ref>

== Distinctions ==
From 2008 to 2013, Salathé was a [[Branco Weiss]] Society in Science Fellow<ref name=":1" /> and in 2018 and again in 2020, he was nominated Switzerland Digital Shaper.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Researchers - BILANZ|url=https://www.handelszeitung.ch/panorama/researchers|access-date=2020-09-14|website=Handelszeitung|language=de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Marcel Salathé - BILANZ|url=https://www.handelszeitung.ch/people/marcel-salathe-0|access-date=2020-09-28|website=Handelszeitung|language=de}}</ref>

Since 2020 he has been a member of the Swiss National COVID-19 Science Task Force, the scientific corona advisory board of the [[Federal Council (Switzerland)|Federal Council]] and the [[Cantons of Switzerland|cantons]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=ncs-tf.ch: Organisation|url=https://ncs-tf.ch/de/organisation|access-date=2020-08-07|website=ncs-tf.ch}}</ref> He chairs the expert group on Digital Epidemiology.<ref>{{Cite web|title=ncs-tf.ch: Topics & Expert groups|url=https://ncs-tf.ch/en/topics-expert-groups#digital_epidemiology|access-date=2020-09-14|website=ncs-tf.ch}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> In November 2020, Salathé was appointed as the president of the [[Swiss National Science Foundation|SNSF]] steering committee for the national research programme "Covid-19".<ref>{{Cite web|title=Election of Steering Committee of NRP 78 "Covid-19" - SNF|url=http://www.snf.ch/en/researchinFocus/newsroom/Pages/news-201104-election-of-steering-committee-of-nrp-78-covid-19.aspx|access-date=2020-11-26|website=www.snf.ch}}</ref>

He is co-founder of the startup AIcrowd that maintains a collaboration platform for data scientists specialized in crowdsourcing [[Artificial intelligence|AI]] solutions.<ref name=":3" />
